definitions.explanation: Prefix attached to nouns to mean either "pure / unmixed" (free of impurities or qualifications) or "net" (after subtracting other amounts). The financial "net" sense is common in business and accounting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{純|じゅん}{利益|りえき}→純利益：18911_junrieki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{純|じゅん}⟦{国産|こくさん}→国産：12017_kokusan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧です。
examples.english: This is a purely domestic product.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年度|こんねんど}→今年度：28220_konnendo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{純|じゅん}⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{前年|ぜんねん}→前年：23906_zennen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伸|の}びた→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
examples.english: This fiscal year's net sales grew significantly compared to the previous year.

notes:
Bound prefix; almost never appears alone. Carries two related senses depending on the following word: "unmixed/genuine" with nouns of kind or origin, and "net" with financial amounts.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{純|じゅん}{利益|りえき}→純利益：18911_junrieki⟧: net profit
- {純|じゅん}⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧: net sales
- {純|じゅん}⟦{国産|こくさん}→国産：12017_kokusan⟧: purely domestic
- ⟦{純|じゅん}{文学|ぶんがく}→純文学：13983_junbungaku⟧: pure literature (literary fiction)
- {純|じゅん}⟦{日本|にほん}{風|ふう}→日本風：26055_nihonfuu⟧: purely Japanese style
- ⟦{純|じゅん}{金|きん}→純金：16997_junkin⟧: pure gold

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{純粋|じゅんすい}→純粋：08673_junsui⟧: pure (na-adjective) — standalone word for purity in feeling or substance
- ⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧〜: total, gross — its financial opposite (⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧ gross sales)
